requirement: Implement RedisTransactionPipeline and RedisPubSubManager classes providing atomic multi/exec pipelines with optimistic locking (watch/unwatch and WatchError retries up to max_retries), transaction rollback/reset on failure, and pubsub channel subscription, publishing, message dispatching, unsubscription, and connection cleanup.
skeleton: RedisTransactionPipeline with optimistic locking retry logic and RedisPubSubManager with message dispatching and channel lifecycle.

rationale.teaches: Redis optimistic locking: watch the keys, retry on WatchError up to max_retries with a sane default, reset the pipeline on failure, and dispatch only real pubsub messages.
rationale.why: A pipeline that retries one time too few or never resets still succeeds when nothing races. The fixture injects a WatchError sequence and counts attempts, which is the only way to observe retry arithmetic.

candidates.why_wrong: max_retries defaults to 0, so the first WatchError fails the transaction instead of retrying.
An empty watch_keys list is accepted, so the transaction runs without optimistic locking at all.
The loop runs max_retries times instead of max_retries plus one, so one fewer attempt is made than configured.
Only subscribe confirmations are dispatched, so published messages never reach the handlers.
The pipeline is not reset after a failure, so the next attempt starts with stale queued commands.
